kim (Security): Auditor request: correlate RBAC rolebinding change to a KMS Decrypt call and the deploy that fixed it. Need ISO8601 timestamps, requestIDs, and a sha256 bundle. Can we get a scrubbed bundle by EOD?
ryan (Infra): yes. Will export k8s audit rolebinding events, cloudtrail KMS Decrypt logs, and CI pipeline deploy events. Using UTC timestamps.
auditor_martin: include exact queries, who ran them, and redaction method. Map exported fields to SOC2 controls (CC6/CC7) in one-page doc.
ryan (Infra): export started: export-id=exp-20260420-b2; destination=s3://redwood-audit/exp-20260420-b2.tar.gz
exporter-bot: export complete at 2026-04-20T17:12:45Z; checksum=sha256:af12bc34deadbeef...c0ffee
kim (Security): scrub run to remove customer PII and preserve service_account, requestID, keyId. uploaded manifest with query text and mapping.pdf. tagging @legal for redaction signoff.
auditor_martin: thanks — presigned link pls and retention window.
ryan (Infra): presigned link sent via DM, 7 days expiry. we included analyst note and signed manifest.
